socket.description: Unix socket path used by the proxy to communicate with gnupg-pkcs11-scd-proxy-server.

scd.description: Path to the underlying smart-card daemon executable.

scd_config.description: Configuration file for the underlying scdaemon; required.

socket_group.description: Unix group to set on the proxy server socket for access control. Leave empty to omit.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging to stderr or log-file.

log_file.description: Path to write log output; leave empty to log to stderr only.

multi_server.description: Run in multi-server mode (foreground) and open a listening UNIX socket in addition to stdin/stdout.

no_detach.description: Prevent daemon from detaching from the controlling terminal (useful for debugging).
